title: Improved health‐related quality of life with tirzepatide versus semaglutide in adults with obesity or overweight from the SURMOUNT‐5 trial
comparison_or_design: The SURMOUNT-5 HRQoL comparison at the maximum tolerated doses.
excluded: All other SF-36 domains and limited-function/weight-loss-category subgroups
PHQ-9, PGI-S, weight-loss efficacy and safety
population_or_material: The overall on-treatment population receiving at least one study dose in this SURMOUNT-5 HRQoL analysis.
requested_items: Arm-level baseline norm-based scores from the source baseline table and week-72 efficacy-model changes/contrasts for PCS/MCS/GH. Exclude duplicated figure baseline means, whole-cohort summaries, other domains and mental-health categorical outcomes.
case_specific_rules: Use Supplementary Table S2 for the requested baseline scores and Figure 1 for week-72 efficacy changes/contrasts. Resolve plotted significance symbols through their legends. Apply the shared rules for denominators, graphical values and conflicting dispersion terminology.
